h1: Reduce MP4 Video Size for Email

dynamicSection.heading: How to Compress Videos for Email Attachments

items.title: Check the Limit
items.content: Most email providers like Gmail and Outlook restrict attachments to 25MB. Ensure your target size is below this limit.

items.title: Adjust Quality Slider
items.content: Drop the quality slider to around 40-50% to achieve maximum compression without making the video unwatchable.

items.title: Download and Attach
items.content: Save the optimized MP4 directly to your device and drag it into your email composer.

faqs.q: What is the maximum video size for Gmail?
faqs.a: Gmail limits attachments to 25MB. If your video is larger, you must compress it using our tool first.

faqs.q: Will the video still look good in an email?
faqs.a: Yes, for casual sharing via email, reducing the bitrate significantly still provides a highly acceptable viewing experience.

faqs.q: Does this work on mobile devices?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our WebAssembly engine runs locally on both iOS and Android browsers, perfect for mobile email.

h1: Convert iPhone MOV to MP4 for Android
description: Fix playback issues by converting Apple MOV videos to universally supported MP4 format for Android users.

items.title: MOV (QuickTime)
items.content: Designed by Apple. Plays flawlessly on iPhones and Macs, but often fails on Android, Windows, and smart TVs.

items.title: MP4 (H.264)
items.content: The universal web standard. Supported natively by 100% of modern devices, ensuring your friends can always watch your clips.

faqs.q: Why do my iPhone videos not play on my Android?
faqs.a: iPhones often record in the MOV container using HEVC codecs, which some Android devices do not natively support.

faqs.q: Will converting MOV to MP4 reduce the quality?
faqs.a: No, we can repackage the video streams into an MP4 container without re-encoding, preserving 100% of the original quality.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything on my Android?
faqs.a: No installation required. Just open this page in Chrome and convert your files instantly.

faqs.a: Yes, we leverage WebCodecs to use your devices GPU, making the high-quality compression extremely fast.
